annotation.title_clean: 海关总署 国家发展改革委 工业和信息化部 财政部 交通运输部 国家移民局 国家铁路局 中国民航局 国铁集团关于智慧口岸建设的指导意见
annotation.title_en: Guiding Opinions on Smart Port-of-Entry Construction (General Administration of Customs et al.)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 海关总署 (General Administration of Customs) with NDRC, MIIT, MOF, MOT, National Immigration Administration, National Railway Administration, CAAC, China State Railway Group
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-agency guiding opinions (Sept 2024) on building smart ports of entry through digital transformation and intelligent upgrades, with targets for 2025, 2030 and 2035. Encourages automated unmanned container terminals, intelligent inspection equipment, a smart port standards system and data security, mainly as innovation promotion.
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets: short-board gaps closed by 2025, hub smart ports by 2025, advanced level by 2030, modern ports by 2035
Encourages automated unmanned container terminals and intelligent handling
Promotes non-intrusive inspection equipment and AIS networking
Builds a smart port standards system and applies national cyber and data security requirements
Customs administration coordinates; local governments bear responsibility and funding
